embeds.title: Welcome to Forever Sixty
embeds.description:
Talk about your class, find a group and tell us what to fix on the site and the addon.

**Start here**
1. Read {{channel:rules}}.
2. Pick your class and faction in **Channels & Roles** at the top of the channel list. Your class channel and name colour come with it. Add your alts too.
3. Say hello in {{channel:general}}.

**On foreversixty.gg**
A guide for every spec, leveling BiS at 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60, a tier list, a sim and a talent planner.
[foreversixty.gg](https://foreversixty.gg/go/discord)

**The addon**
Marks upgrades in your bags, marks your next talent and puts your rotation on the character panel.
[Get set up](https://foreversixty.gg/setup?golink=discord)

**Something broken?**
Open a post in {{channel:bugs}} with a tag. Quick questions go in {{channel:addon}}.

embeds.title: Rules
embeds.description:
**1. Be decent.** Argue about builds all you like. Go after the argument, never the person. No harassment, slurs or hate.

**2. No spam or self-promotion.** Guild ads, streams and invite links go in {{channel:lfg}} and nowhere else. No unsolicited DMs to members.

**3. No real-money trading.** No selling or buying accounts, gold, boosts, carries or power-leveling for real money.

**4. Follow the Blizzard and Discord Terms of Service.** No cheats, exploits, botting or third-party tools that break them.

**5. Keep personal info private.** Yours and everyone else's. No real names, addresses or photos of people without their consent.

**6. Tag spoilers.** Wrap new raid and quest spoilers in ||spoiler tags|| for the first week after they come out.

**7. Moderators have the final say.** If something is wrong, ping {{role:moderator}} or message a moderator rather than arguing it out in the channel.

Breaking a rule gets a warning, a timeout or a ban, depending on how bad it is.

embeds.title: Forever launches 4 November
embeds.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever opens <t:1793833200:F> (<t:1793833200:R>).

Before you log in:
- Read your spec's guide. Shamans carry one weapon, Survival hunters fight in melee, and there are six new race and class pairs.
- Check your leveling BiS for 20 and 30 so you know which quest rewards to take.
- Install the addon so your bags tell you what is an upgrade.

[foreversixty.gg](https://foreversixty.gg/go/discord)

See you in Azeroth.

embeds.title: How to post
embeds.description:
One post, everything a reader needs:

**Class and spec, level, faction, ruleset, what you need**

`Prot warrior, 60, Horde, PvP, LF Strat UD healer + 2 dps`
`Guild recruiting: Alliance, Normal, raids Tue/Thu 8pm ST, need resto shaman and holy priest`

Guild ads and invite links are allowed here and nowhere else.
